Protected map (managed forest code 20) used in the Forest Management in Canada, 2020 story map.  
  
  Protected map (managed forest code 20) created from protected areas within the Canadian Protected and Conserved Areas database. The protected map is used in the Story Map of Forest Management in Canada, 2020 (Aménagement des forêts au Canada, 2020) and includes the following tiled layer: Tile Layer of Protected Managed Forest Code 20: 2020
